name: 7 Days Cairo, Luxor & Hurghada Tour
description: Experience the best of Egypt with our 7 Days Egypt Tour Package, combining Cairo, Luxor, and Hurghada in one unforgettable journey with ibis Egypt Tours. Explore the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum, Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, and relax on the crystal-clear beaches of the Red Sea. This private Egypt tour is perfect for travelers seeking history, culture, and leisure in one itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: As you step foot in Cairo, the vibrant energy of the city envelops you. After your flight arrives at Cairo International Airport, Our friendly guide will be waiting at the airport to greet you with a warm smile and assist you to finish all formalities with you, and then Ibis Egypt Tours representative will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Take a moment to relax and soak in the anticipation of the incredible experiences that lie ahead. Meals: (No Meals)

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour - Unveiling Ancient Wonders/ Tourist Sleeper Train Cairo to Luxor
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast to fuel your day, your Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel. Today, get ready to be captivated by the wonders of Cairo. Your first stop is the legendary Pyramids of Giza. As you stand before the awe-inspiring pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus, you will feel the weight of history and marvel at their grandeur. Do not forget to take some fantastic photos from the Panorama area, where you can capture the perfect shot of these iconic structures. Next, prepare to encounter the enigmatic Sphinx and visit the fascinating Valley Temple. Afterward, indulge in a scrumptious lunch at a delightful oriental restaurant in Cairo. However, the adventure does not end there! Hop on a Sleeper Train and journey to Luxor, where you will explore the renowned Egyptian Museum, home to countless treasures from ancient Egypt. As the day ends, you will be transferred to the Giza train station to board the Sleeper Train. Enjoy a delicious dinner and settle in for a comfortable overnight journey. Overnight on a sleeping train heading to Luxor.) Meals: Breakfast – Lunch - Dinner

itinerary.title: Arrival Luxor /Karnak and Luxor Temples Tour - Where Gods and Pharaohs Converge
itinerary.description: Wake up to the beauty of Luxor as your Ibis Egypt tours representative greets you at the train station. Today, you will explore Luxor's East Bank and immerse yourself in the grandeur of Karnak and Luxor Temples. Walk in the footsteps of ancient gods and behold the awe-inspiring architecture that has stood the test of time. Enjoy your Lunch at a good local resturant in Luxor. Finally, transfer to your hotel in Luxor, where you can reflect on the mysteries you've uncovered and prepare for the next chapter of your journey. Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

itinerary.title: West Bank Tour / Luxor to Hurghada city
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast. Our Egyptology tour guide will join you to visit Hatshepsut temple, Colossi of Memnon & Valley of the Kings. Finally, travel to Hurghada by VIP group bus; catch your bus trip a journey of around four hours. Check into your hotel, and spend the final few days of your holiday relaxing and soaking up the sun - or swimming, diving and snorkeling in the warm, clear waters of the Red Sea. Meals (Breakfast & Dinner)

itinerary.title: Free Day in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast at the hotel, relax on sunny and sandy beaches and enjoy plenty of water activities. Try optional tours to explore the underwater world during the amazing wonderful Snorkeling tours to Orange bay or Paradise Island. Overnight in Hurghada. Meals Breakfast- Lunch & Dinner

itinerary.title: Hurghada to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast at the hotel, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will escort you to Hurghada bus station to catch your bus back to Cairo. Ibis representative will escort you to your hotel in Cairo Optional Cairo Night tour to explore Cairo beauty and culture. Overnight in Cairo. Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today, we bid farewell to Egypt. After enjoying your delicious breakfast, please check out by 12:00 PM. Ibis Egypt Tours Representative will accompany you to Cairo International Airport for your departure. Meals (Breakfast)
